A wide establishing vista of Mexico City in a far-future cyberpunk world — environment key art for a game world map, with no people.

The place: Mexico City two centuries from now, a far-future megacity in a high mountain valley ringed by snow-capped volcanoes, its long-drained lake brought back to life: slender towers of white ceramic and glass rising from the water, linked by curving causeways of light; terraced floating gardens in marigold and magenta bloom drifting slowly across the lake; the white marble palace with its flowing Art Nouveau curves kept exactly as it stands in a soft glow; the tall column crowned in gold kept exactly as it stands at the heart of a tree-lined avenue of light; quiet flying vehicles and sky couriers threading between the towers and banners of cut light drifting in the air under a clear night sky.

Composition: a sweeping view from a high vantage point at a three-quarter angle, layered depth — framing elements in the near foreground, the city spread across the middle ground, mountains and sky far behind. The whole city reads at a glance as one memorable skyline. Keep the lower quarter of the picture calm and slightly darker (water, terrace or treetops without detail clutter) so interface cards can sit over it.

Style: painterly environment key art matching Korean MMORPG character artwork — 2D painting with visible brushwork, layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, a few crisp accents; rich atmospheric perspective and luminous light.

No people, no characters, no animals in focus; no text, letters, numbers, signs, logos or watermark; no frame or border.

Output: one horizontal 3:2 image, 1536×1024.
